name: Hex Trust USDX
oneLiner: USDX is Hex Trust's U.S. dollar stablecoin redeemable 1:1, backed by 1-3 month U.S. Treasury bills and cash at tier-1 banks under Hong Kong issuer disclosures.
collateral: Cash and cash equivalents, primarily 1–3 month U.S. Treasury bills held at global tier-1 financial institutions

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDX is described as a 1:1 USD-referencing token backed by Treasuries and cash equivalents with approved-party redemption.

mintAuthority.summary: USDX is an issuer-operated UUPS/OFT token on Ethereum, Flare, and Songbird. The active MINTER_ROLE set is two EOAs on Ethereum and one shared EOA on Flare and Songbird; the default admin can grant roles, while a secondary UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE EOA is also present on Ethereum and Flare.

controls.label: USDX active MINTER_ROLE EOA
controls.capDescription: No aggregate supply ceiling was identified in the verified implementation; this EOA can call the MINTER_ROLE-gated mint function, subject to the issuer's operational controls.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530752, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xf28a91a1...) returned true on the proxy. The verified implementation exposes mint(address,uint256) gated by MINTER_ROLE, with no aggregate supply ceiling in the reviewed source.

controls.label: USDX active MINTER_ROLE EOA

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530752, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x6329218f...) returned true on the proxy. The verified implementation exposes mint(address,uint256) gated by MINTER_ROLE, with no aggregate supply ceiling in the reviewed source.

controls.label: USDX default admin / upgrade admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530752, Flare block 65060282, and Songbird block 127737529, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb8ce31ad...) and owner() both resolved to this EOA on every proxy. The address also has UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE on all three deployments, and the verified UUPS implementation gates upgrades through the default admin or UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE. No Safe setup was verified.

controls.label: USDX secondary UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE EOA - Ethereum
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530752, hasRole(UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x47345bb8...) returned true. Verified UUPS source gates _authorizeUpgrade with UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE (and the default-admin path where applicable); this EOA has no DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE or MINTER_ROLE.

controls.label: USDX secondary UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE EOA - Flare
controls.evidence: At Flare block 65060282, hasRole(UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x47345bb8...) returned true. Verified HexTrustUSDV2 source gates the upgrade authorization path through UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE; this EOA has no DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE or MINTER_ROLE.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530752, Flare block 65060282, and Songbird block 127737529, the EIP-1967 implementation slots returned 0xce2d107b..., 0x35151b..., and 0xF34A47..., respectively, while the proxy-admin slot was zero on all three deployments. owner() and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb8ce31ad...) returned the same default-admin EOA on every deployment. hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, ...) returned true for 0xf28a91a1... and 0x6329218f... on Ethereum, and for 0x6329218f... on Flare and Songbird. hasRole(UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb8ce31ad...) returned true on all three; 0x47345bb8... also held UPGRADE_ADMIN_ROLE on Ethereum and Flare. Verified source gates mint() with MINTER_ROLE and _authorizeUpgrade with the upgrade-admin path. Follow-up 2026-07-20: (1) The active minter EOAs are Hex Trust operational backend keys that submit mint/burn transactions directly on-chain; issuer documentation (htdigitalassets.com) describes USDX mint/redeem as an issuer-operated process under Hex Trust's licensed custody, and no public source names them as custody-vault or treasury addresses. (2) No on-chain policy or approval-flow constraint exists beyond MINTER_ROLE — the verified implementation exposes no supply ceiling or mint timelock; any custody approval flow is off-chain and not observable. Both questions are answered to the limit of public evidence.
